home.heroTitle: Work found through people you know
home.heroBody: In a small town, a job is filled by whoever the employer happens to phone. Koode puts the word of a known local person on record, so good work is remembered.
home.step1Body: A member of the association writes down who you are and how they know your work. Their name stays on it.
home.step2Body: We send you a message. Your profile stays hidden until you accept it. You can refuse, and nothing is shown.
home.step3Body: When a shop or firm nearby needs someone, they can see who vouched for you and what they said.
home.tiersBody: A loading worker and a chartered accountant get the same profile, the same recommendations, the same respect.
home.trustTitle: Backed by people who can be asked
home.trustBody: Every recommendation carries a real name, and verified members carry a badge their neighbours can check. Nothing here is an anonymous star rating.
home.ctaBody: Looking for work? Just browse — no account needed. Hiring? Sign up with an e-mail or Google.
home.heroEyebrow: Local work, on the strength of a local word
home.heroScrollHint: Scroll to see how it works
home.heroGraphCaption: A picture of the network Koode builds: people, and the recommendations that connect them.
home.mismatchTitle: The shortage is not of work
home.mismatchBody: People looking for work and employers looking for people are both searching, and neither can see the other. Koode closes that gap.
home.heroTagline: Local jobs. Real opportunities. Better lives.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.intro: Koode stores your name, mobile number and the work you do, so that local employers can find you.
consent.pointPhone: Your mobile number is never shown in search results. It is revealed only when someone deliberately asks for it, and we keep a record of every time that happens.
consent.pointRecommendations: People may write recommendations about you. You will always be told who wrote one and what it says.
consent.pointControl: You can download everything we hold about you, or delete your account, at any time.
consent.pointNoSelling: We do not sell your details to anyone, and we do not use advertising trackers.

v2.intro: Koode stores your name, the contact details you publish, and the work you do, so that local employers and workers can find each other.
v2.pointContact: Your contact number and e-mail are never shown in search results. They are revealed only when someone deliberately asks, and we keep a record of every time that happens.
v2.pointRecommendations: People may write recommendations about you. You will always be told who wrote one and what it says.
v2.pointControl: You can download everything we hold about you, or delete your account, at any time.
v2.pointNoSelling: We do not sell your details to anyone, and we do not use advertising trackers.

about.title: One opportunity can change a life. Thousands can change a place.
about.lede: Koode is a community-run platform for work in and around Edakkara — built so that the people who need work and the people who need workers can actually find each other.
about.problemTitle: The shortage is not of work
about.problemBody: Thousands of young people are running from place to place looking for work that suits them. At the same time, employers are struggling to find people they can trust to do the job. Both sides are searching. Neither can see the other. That gap — not a lack of jobs — is what holds a local economy back.
about.problemSeekerBody: Qualified, capable people with no way to be seen beyond whoever already knows them.
about.problemEmployerBody: Employers filling a role with whoever they happen to be able to phone that day.
about.answerBody: Koode brings people offering work and people looking for it under a single roof, run by the community rather than by an outside company. The larger aim is straightforward: strengthen the local economy of Kerala by keeping opportunity, and the people who can take it up, in the same place.
about.breadthBody: Work is not one shape. Koode carries the full range, from a day's work down the road to a role with a company that never needs you to leave home.
about.ecosystemBody: Every recommendation on Koode carries a real name, and every person raised up strengthens the next. That is the point: not a listings board, but a community ecosystem that belongs to the people using it.
